rule: Partials expose only the prefix agreed by two readings and never retract shown words. Finals apply whole-word replacements only. Finishing drains every captured frame, including frames queued during an in-flight preview, before final inference. Finishing after silence does not re-read unchanged speech; cancelling discards queued frames, returns no text and stops capture. Live PCM capture includes silence and settled turns in a positive finite maxSeconds limit, default 300; exceeding it stops capture with too-large. Default Whisper finals use 30-second windows with 5-second overlap, align shared words without token timestamp cuts, and preserve full model context per window.
